Select exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, standard_relation =, and require pubmed_id or doi to be non-null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
